Dongying ZhaoRui Science & Trading Co., Ltd is a chemical company based at 233 Zhenxinglu, Kenli County, Dongying, China, serving customers who require dependable chemical products and responsive trading support. Located in Dongying—an important industrial and logistics hub in Shandong Province—the company is positioned to connect domestic manufacturing resources with international demand through efficient sourcing, coordination, and shipment planning.

As a science-and-trading enterprise, Dongying ZhaoRui focuses on supplying chemicals for a wide range of downstream industries, such as industrial processing, manufacturing, and formulated product production. The company supports clients with product selection, specification confirmation, and procurement planning, helping buyers match their technical requirements with suitable grades and packaging options. In addition to product supply, Dongying ZhaoRui emphasizes practical service capabilities, including order management, documentation support for cross-border trade, and coordination with logistics partners to meet delivery schedules.

Quality and consistency are central concerns in chemical purchasing, and the company’s trading workflow is oriented toward clear communication on specifications, labeling, and handling requirements, helping customers manage compliance and safe use throughout the supply chain. By combining local market knowledge in Dongying with trading experience, Dongying ZhaoRui Science & Trading Co., Ltd aims to be a reliable partner for customers seeking steady chemical supply, efficient transactions, and long-term cooperation.
